description: Figure 6(a) is a vertical bar chart titled “Self-reflection SFT data statistic,” illustrating the “Statistics of reasoning-type distribution in different stages of training.” The horizontal axis displays six distinct reasoning categories, labeled from left to right as “Mathematical Reasoning,” “General Reasoning,” “Natural Scene Reasoning,” “Physical Reasoning,” “Logical Puzzle Reasoning,” and “Chemical Reasoning.” The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Samples,” uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10² to 10⁴, with tick marks indicating powers of ten. Each bar corresponds to a category and is colored light blue; the exact number of samples for each category is numerically labeled atop its respective bar. The bars are arranged in descending order of height, with “Mathematical Reasoning” being the tallest at 7025 samples, followed by “General Reasoning” at 1709, “Natural Scene Reasoning” at 413, “Physical Reasoning” at 232, “Logical Puzzle Reasoning” at 91, and “Chemical Reasoning” being the shortest at 49 samples. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their numerical labels.
